references.use: Inset category tabs, stone background, item frames, completed gold accents and persistent per-world progress. Original CSS; no Minecraft assets copied.

references.access: Previously user-supplied encounter reference and screenshots
references.use: Arena angular dark panels, cyan outlines, white italic headings and triangular target reticle. An inspired UI, not a verified exact reproduction.

audio: Original synthesized four-note notification; challenge adds a fifth. Arena notices use the isolated Titan effects bus; Overworld uses the normal audio bus.
controls: Left stick free inventory cursor; right stick scroll; confirm pick/place; attack split/place one and drag-paint; inventory quick-transfer; D-pad steps between slots. Focus mode remains configurable.
targeting: View-angle and reach weighted acquisition, persistent body region, manual-camera grace, range release and independent swept contact. No actor warp.
handling: Giganto's physical movement rates shared with Wyvern. Pursuit boost remains faster to close on the moving boss. No balance or world generation changes.
